Tanjug reports water interruptions naming Voždovac and Surčin, yet the event’s geographic scope is unconfirmed; the headline alone cannot validate a local outage [F6].

prognoza.naslov: Odbijena formulacija (EN): Parking Servis is receiving recent data, but the largest displayed movement at VMA has no measurement time, so its spatial meaning remains open [F4, F5]. The new headlines add city-relevant signals, including a heating complaint and public-transport information, but their geographic scope is not confirmed [F7, F8, F23].

Odbijena formulacija (EN): Connector's shared interruption dissolves against the current facts: Parking Servis arrived 21 min ago [F4], RHMZ 21 min ago [F27], the airport METAR 21 min ago [F28], and citizen sensors 16 min ago [F3] - the collection is running, not paused. What the facts actually carry is selective silence: SEPA has 0 of 24 expected slots in 24 h [F2] and Blic 0 of 96 [F25], which points at individual sources, not a common pipe. Observer is right that the Obilićev venac move from 32 to 391 is only a display difference with no measurement time [F5], so nothing in it supports a timed emptying of the garage.
razlog: reads silence as nothing having happened

prognoza.naslov: Odbijena formulacija (EN): Four instrument feeds carry the same 12-minute reception age - the citizen field with 45 instruments and 5384 values [F3], Parking Servis with 27 locations and 351 values [F4], RHMZ Košutnjak with 2 instruments and 130 values [F27], and DanubeHIS with 3 instruments [F35] - while METAR sits at 27 minutes [F28], so the boundary Connector wants to test looks like one polling tick of ours rather than anything the city did. Skeptic's "near fortyfold" is stale: Obilićev venac now reads from 72 to 392 free spaces between the first and last reception in the window, with no measurement time [F5], and the same source states it publishes no measurement time at all [F4]. Meanwhile Blic's channel shows nothing arrived in 6 h, 0 of 96 slots [F25], yet a Blic headline about cable theft paralysing trains in Belgrade is what the link organelle keeps pairing with three unrelated media headlines at 0.74, 0.74 and 0.73 [F38][F39][F40].
